description: This file defines React functional components that serve as skeleton placeholders for loading states in a video streaming platform. It provides visual placeholders for video cards, grid layouts of cards, and a video player, enhancing user experience during data loading.

methods.name: SkeletonCard
methods.description: A React component returning a skeleton placeholder for a video card, including a thumbnail and title lines.

methods.name: SkeletonGrid
methods.description: A React component rendering a responsive grid of SkeletonCard placeholders, with configurable count.

methods.name: SkeletonPlayer
methods.description: A React component displaying a large placeholder simulating a video player with metadata lines.
